dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge exhibiting a smooth hyperbolic spline from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a measurable pixel radius, lacking any acute termination points.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep convex anterior margin ascending at a high angle relative to the horizontal dorsal axis before tapering toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The maximum base width is approximately 1.5 times the maximum vertical height of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of numerous small white punctate markings and superficial linear striations across the dark lateral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The fin structure exhibits a highly attenuated and posteriorly recurved distal half.
